capabilities: Rename tabs and assign colors from the tab context menu
Create new notes in the last-clicked folder instead of vault root
Add a Print command to markdown file context menus and the palette
Toggle between reading and edit mode with E and Escape
Cycle note width presets and set compact table density
disambiguation: Not a single-purpose utility; it bundles seven independent, individually toggleable tweaks in one plugin.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Beta builds can be installed via BRAT; features are conflict-aware and opt-in.
problem: Obsidian lacks several small quality-of-life conveniences (tab renaming, context-aware note placement, print access, quick mode toggling) that each would require a separate plugin to add.
summary: A toolkit of small opt-in UX upgrades: tab rename/colors, smart new-note placement, print menu item, edit-mode hotkeys, and note-width controls.
